english: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied RPG portrait into a dialogue sprite with a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Preserve the exact identities, number of people, faces, hairstyles, expressions, poses, hands, clothing, carried objects, colors, painterly rendering and original framing. Keep the entire existing character silhouettes and carried equipment opaque, with clean detailed alpha edges around hair and clothing. All surrounding background becomes transparent. Output one isolated portrait image.
japanese: 元のRPG肖像を実際のRGBA透過背景の会話用立ち絵へ編集します。人数、人物の同一性、顔、髪型、表情、姿勢、手、服装、持ち物、色、描画タッチ、元の構図を保持し、周囲の背景を透明にします。
